name: ultimate-engine
description: Lint/tooling manifest for this repo's JavaScript/mjs surface. No runtime package is published from here — the engine's Node code (tools/graphify, tools/lib, tools/mermaid-engine, tools/visual-engine) has zero third-party runtime dependencies by design (see CONFIGURATION.md). This file exists solely so `npm install` reproduces a pinned lint toolchain: `node_modules/` is gitignored and regenerated on demand, matching the same 'regenerable dependencies, not vendored' policy already used for tools/docgen/requirements.txt.
